stories.headline: Google launches Deep Review publicly
stories.summary: Google Research released Deep Review, an AI system for rigorous feedback and verification on complex technical documents.
stories.why_it_matters: Useful for research, reviews, and trust checks on AI-written work.

stories.headline: OpenAI shares math research results
stories.summary: OpenAI published new mathematics results from an internal frontier model and released proof formalizations and technical details.
stories.why_it_matters: A notable research signal on AI-assisted discovery.

stories.headline: Google opens geospatial agents

stories.why_it_matters: Another step toward practical AI agents for science and mapping.
